scope: Magpie-connected composer model selector runtime verification

environment.bridge: Real Lake Magpie bridge reader with synthetic credentials and a loopback model endpoint
environment.frontend: Verified both Vite development page and signed binary embedded production assets

fixes: Bootstrap now supplies public selection metadata so opaque Magpie routes display labels and manufacturer icons before opening the menu
Selection presentation follows provider/model identity instead of the first matching name across sources
Manufacturer parsing supports human labels with slash-separated routing notes
Opening the menu refreshes bootstrap alongside the catalog to follow changes to the Magpie default
Current-model presentation remains available during catalog loading
runtimeChecks: 70 options rendered in Magpie and manual source groups; source search returns all 68 Magpie entries
Switch between identical model names in Magpie and manual sources without mixing labels or icons
Reload retains the selected source and correct label/icon before opening the menu
Synthetic chat completed with OK; captured loopback request used route/opaque-claude-check
Changes to the Magpie default appear on menu open without page reload
Legacy bridge without a catalog shows its single model
Disconnect falls back to saved manual models; reconnect restores the Magpie group and saved selection
430px viewport: long labels/IDs wrap, trigger truncates with a full tooltip, selected check and settings footer remain visible
Embedded production page renders 70 options with zero missing brand images in dark mode
limitations: This verifies Lake’s real integration reader, APIs, selection persistence, chat routing, and browser UI using an isolated synthetic Magpie bridge. It does not validate an external Magpie account, plugin installation, or paid upstream model service.
privacy: No production model configuration or credentials were copied or changed. Public bootstrap metadata was regression-tested not to expose keys, credential references, or endpoint URLs.
cleanup: Temporary tab closed, viewport reset, isolated Vite/backend stopped; final signed Lake Dev installed and relaunched. Native startup exposes the saved model name and actual provider without opening the menu.
